response.justification: While Bogdan possesses an impressive technical background with strong open-source contributions and software craftsmanship, he falls short on critical requirements for this Head of Development role. He lacks a proven track record of executive-level team management and only possesses basic German skills, whereas C1 is strictly required for client advisory and operational leadership.
strengths: Extensive senior-level software engineering experience across modern stacks, including TypeScript, Node.js, and Dlang.
Strong commitment to open-source technologies and community building, evidenced by founding GISCollective and hosting technical workshops.
Solid foundation in software architecture, software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD), and modern deployment infrastructure.
concerns: Does not meet the mandatory German language requirement (possesses Basic, requires minimum C1).
Lacks a proven track record in executive-level leadership, operational client management, and formal team management.
Missing explicit experience with formal UML modeling, enterprise IT security, and risk compliance.
